title: Power BI Sharing and Permission Changes
dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.
app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log; Power BI REST Admin API and on-prem data gateway logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=o365:management:activity Workload=PowerBI (Activity=ShareReport OR Activity=AddedWorkspaceUsers OR Activity=UpdatedWorkspaceAccess)
| stats count as changes by UserId, Activity, WorkspaceName
| sort - changes
description: Audits sharing and workspace-access changes in Power BI so unexpected grants, external shares, or bulk permission changes are visible for governance and security review.
value: Over-sharing of Power BI content is a common data-leak vector; auditing permission changes supports both governance reviews and breach investigations.
implementation: Ingest the activity log; schedule hourly; alert on external sharing or sensitive-workspace changes. Route to your data-governance and security teams.
visualization: Table of sharing events by user, timechart of permission changes, alert.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities (audit log)

grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who shares Power BI reports and changes who can see them, so sensitive numbers do not end up with the wrong people.
